title: Seasonal Allergies and Accidents

authors: Akesaka, Mika, Shigeoka, Hitoshi
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Seasonal allergies affect over 400 million people globally, yet the broader economic consequences of pollen exposure remain understudied. Evidence from Japan’s ambulance records suggests that high-pollen days are associated with increases in accidents, including traffic accidents and work-related injuries, which may reflect impaired cognitive performance. Retail scanner data and cellphone mobility records indicate that individuals already engage in avoidance behaviors, such as purchasing allergy products and limiting outdoor activities on weekends. This suggests that relying on individual self-protection may be insufficient to offset these risks, and thus greater government intervention may be warranted to mitigate pollen-related harm.
abstract_zh: 季节性过敏影响全球超过4亿人口，然而花粉暴露带来的更广泛经济后果仍未得到充分研究。来自日本救护车记录的证据表明，高花粉日与事故增加相关，包括交通事故和工作相关伤害，这可能反映了认知能力受损。零售扫描数据和手机移动记录显示，个体已采取回避行为，如购买过敏产品并在周末限制户外活动。这表明依赖个体自我保护可能不足以抵消这些风险，因此可能需要加强政府干预以减轻花粉相关危害。

title: The Impact of Carcinogenic Risk Exposure on Housing Values: Estimates from Chemical Reclassifications

authors: Jules van Binsbergen, João F. Cocco, Marco Grotteria, Lakshmi Naaraayanan
official: 官方在线 2025-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We quantify the impact of perceived cancer risk on housing values using widely advertised national reclassifications of chemical carcinogenicity in the United States. Combining these information events with an empirical design that compares changes in house values closer to affected toxic plants against those farther away isolates the effect of cancer risk news from other local factors. Focusing on plants previously emitting reclassified carcinogenic chemicals, we estimate a 1-2% decline in housing values within a 3-mile radius compared to those located farther away. The effects are stronger in areas with higher media presence underscoring the role of salience as a mechanism.

authors: Hind Benkirane (UH2C - Université Hassan II de Casablanca = University of Hassan II Casablanca = جامعة الحسن الثاني (ar)), Naima Idouaarabe (Université Sultan Moulay Slimane de Béni Mellal)

abstract: The rapid growth of private higher education institutions (PHEIs) in Morocco is an emerging phenomenon that brings several challenges, notably high staff turnover. In this context, attracting and retaining faculty members represent a strategic priority for PHEIs to ensure a sustainable competitive advantage and strengthen their employer brand. This brand relies on both an external dimension, oriented toward students (Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019), and an internal dimension focused on employees, which is recognized as essential (Chapleo et al. 2019). A review of the existing literature reveals a near-total absence of research addressing the link between employer branding in higher education institutions and the attraction and retention of top talent, whether in Morocco or elsewhere. This article explores the internal approach through a qualitative study involving 18 professors from two private business and engineering schools, using thematic content analysis. Our findings reveal that developing an employer brand within PHEIs is vital. However, other attractive attributes also influence teachers' decision-making processes regarding their choice of institution, such as work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, and career development. Keywords: Employer brand, private higher education institution, work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, career development.
abstract_zh: 摩洛哥私立高等教育机构的迅速增长是一个新兴现象，带来了诸多挑战，尤其是高员工流动率问题。在此背景下，吸引并留住教职员工成为私立高等教育机构确保可持续竞争优势、强化雇主品牌的一项战略优先事项。这一品牌既包含面向学生的外部维度（Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019），也包含聚焦于员工的内部维度，后者被认为是至关重要的（Chapleo et al. 2019）。对现有文献的回顾显示，无论是在摩洛哥还是其他地方，关于高等教育机构雇主品牌与顶尖人才吸引及保留之间联系的研究几乎完全缺失。本文通过一项涉及两所私立商业与工程学校的18位教授的定性研究，采用主题内容分析法，探讨了内部路径。我们的研究结果表明，在私立高等教育机构中发展雇主品牌至关重要。然而，其他具有吸引力的属性也影响着教师在选择院校时的决策过程，例如工作与生活的平衡、道德行为、管理风格、薪酬以及职业发展。关键词：雇主品牌，私立高等教育机构，工作与生活平衡，道德行为，管理风格，薪酬，职业发展。

title: Credit Cycles and Creditor Rights
title_zh: 信贷周期与债权人权利
title_primary: 信贷周期与债权人权利
title_secondary: Credit Cycles and Creditor Rights
authors: Martin Kornejew, Shohini Kundu, Karsten Müller
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do creditor rights amplify or dampen economic fluctuations? Using a panel of 39 countries from 1978 to 2019, we show that credit expansions in economies with strong creditor protection are followed by smaller output losses, fewer non-performing loans, and a greater reallocation of credit away from unproductive sectors. Firm-level evidence from Delaware’s adoption of antirecharacterization laws shows that well-protected creditors cut credit to low-productivity firms while easing borrowing constraints for productive ones. Overall, our findings indicate that stronger creditor rights dampen the output losses of credit booms by facilitating a more efficient reallocation of capital.
abstract_zh: 债权人权利是放大还是抑制经济波动？利用1978年至2019年间39个国家的面板数据，我们发现，在债权人保护较强的经济体中，信贷扩张之后伴随的产出损失较小，不良贷款较少，且信贷从低效部门向高效部门的再配置更为显著。来自特拉华州采纳反定性法律的微观企业证据表明，受到良好保护的债权人会削减对低生产率企业的信贷，同时放宽对高生产率企业的融资约束。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，更强的债权人权利通过促进资本更有效的再配置，减轻了信贷繁荣带来的产出损失。

title: Profiting from Regulation: The Effects of Emissions Standards on Abatement R&D

title_primary: 从监管中获利：排放标准对减排研发的影响
title_secondary: Profiting from Regulation: The Effects of Emissions Standards on Abatement R&D
authors: Johanna-Sophia Hardt, Heidrun C. Hoppe-Wewetzer, Felix Klapper, James Fenske, Muhammad Haseeb 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-09 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores the impact of emissions standards on a firm’s output and abatement R&D investment decisions in a duopoly model, extending the work of Amir et al. (2023). It is shown that high upper limits on total emissions remove the firms’ incentives to invest in abatement R&D. This helps firms to coordinate on profit-increasing output levels relative to unregulated markets. Moreover, subsidies for abatement R&D may hurt firms, but improve welfare when the regulation is strict enough.
abstract_zh: 本文在双寡头模型框架下，探讨了排放标准对企业产出及减排研发投资决策的影响，并扩展了Amir等人（2023）的研究。研究表明，较高的总排放上限会削弱企业投资于减排研发的动机，这有助于企业在相对于无管制市场时协调至利润提升的产出水平。此外，当管制足够严格时，对减排研发的补贴可能损害企业利益，但能改善社会福利。

title: Firms’ expectations and uncertainty during COVID-19: Evidence from Italian firms
title_zh: 新冠疫情下企业的预期与不确定性：来自意大利企业的证据
title_primary: 新冠疫情下企业的预期与不确定性：来自意大利企业的证据
title_secondary: Firms’ expectations and uncertainty during COVID-19: Evidence from Italian firms
authors: Agar Brugiavini, Roberto Casarin, Michele Costola, Claudia Crivellenti
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how the COVID-19 pandemic affected Italian firms’ expectations regarding future growth and prices, and the link between firm-level uncertainty and forecast errors. Using firm-level panel data from the Bank of Italy’s INVIND survey, we document that growth-expectation formation is stable across nearly three decades, including the COVID-19 pandemic, and that growth forecasts retain predictive content for realized outcomes in every year of the sample. Firms’ self-reported uncertainty about growth is informative about forecast accuracy in crisis years but not during 2020–2021, when uncertainty was driven by a common aggregate shock. At the aggregate level, cross-sectional disagreement among firms predicts the dispersion of subsequent realized outcomes, with predictability running only from expectations to outcomes. Workforce shortages are the dominant channel through which the pandemic disrupted firm expectations, more relevant than demand, supply, or financial channels. The price domain differs from real growth, with the response of expected prices to realized prices weakening during the late 1990s, the 2008–2009 financial crisis, and the 2022 inflation surge, while subjective price uncertainty remains a stable predictor of forecast errors.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了COVID-19疫情如何影响意大利企业对未来增长和价格的预期，以及企业层面不确定性与预测误差之间的联系。利用意大利央行INVIND调查的企业层面面板数据，我们记录了增长预期形成机制在近三十年间保持稳定，包括COVID-19疫情期间，且增长预测在样本中的每一年都对实际结果具有预测内容。企业自我报告的增长不确定性在危机年份对预测准确性具有信息价值，但在2020-2021年期间则不然，彼时不确定性由共同的总体冲击驱动。在总体层面，企业间的横截面分歧能够预测后续实际结果的离散程度，且预测性仅从预期传导至结果。劳动力短缺是疫情扰乱企业预期的主要渠道，其重要性超过需求、供给或金融渠道。价格领域与实际增长有所不同，预期价格对实际价格的响应在1990年代末、2008-2009年金融危机及2022年通胀飙升期间有所减弱，而主观价格不确定性始终是预测误差的稳定预测因子。

title: Wealth Tax, Entrepreneurship, and the Legal Form of Business Organization
title_zh: 财富税、创业精神与企业组织的法律形式
title_primary: 财富税、创业精神与企业组织的法律形式
title_secondary: Wealth Tax, Entrepreneurship, and the Legal Form of Business Organization
authors: Alessandro Di Nola, Almuth Scholl, Haomin Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the effects of wealth taxation on efficiency, equity, and welfare in a heterogeneous-agent model with incomplete markets and endogenous occupational and legal-form choice. Entrepreneurs choose between operating as pass-through businesses and C-corporations. While C-corporations face less favorable tax treatment and higher operating costs, they benefit from easier access to external finance. The choice of legal form therefore shapes both the after-tax return to entrepreneurial investment and the severity of financial constraints. Calibrating the model to the U.S. economy, we show that the effects of wealth taxation depend crucially on the endogenous reallocation of entrepreneurs across legal forms. Revenue-neutral reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to switch toward pass-through businesses tighten financial constraints, exacerbate capital misallocation within the entrepreneurial sector, and amplify the efficiency costs of wealth taxation. By contrast, reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to organize as C-corporations relax financial constraints, improve capital allocation, and can more than offset the aggregate distortions induced by the wealth tax. We further show that the distributional and welfare effects crucially depend on the design of the wealth tax itself. While a flat wealth tax does not lower wealth inequality, it generates aggregate welfare gains under all revenue-recycling schemes we consider. By contrast, a progressive wealth tax reduces inequality but may generate aggregate welfare losses because it more strongly discourages entrepreneurial investment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全市场及内生职业与法律形式选择下的异质性主体模型中，财富税对效率、公平和福利的影响。企业家可以选择以穿透型企业或C型公司形式运营。尽管C型公司面临较不利的税收待遇和更高的运营成本，但它们更容易获得外部融资。因此，法律形式的选择既塑造了企业家投资的税后回报，也影响了金融约束的严重程度。通过将模型校准至美国经济，我们表明财富税的影响关键取决于企业家在法律形式间的内生重新配置。鼓励企业家转向穿透型企业的收入中性改革会收紧金融约束，加剧企业家部门内部的资本错配，并放大财富税的效率成本。相反，鼓励企业家组建C型公司的改革则能放松金融约束，改善资本配置，并可能超过财富税带来的总体扭曲。我们进一步表明，分配和福利效应关键取决于财富税本身的设计。虽然统一财富税并未降低财富不平等，但在我们考虑的所有收入循环方案下，它都能带来总体福利增益。相比之下，累进财富税减少了不平等，但可能因更强烈地抑制企业家投资而产生总体福利损失。

title_primary: 最低工资法与求职行为

authors: Vitor Melo, Christopher M. Kaiser, David Neumark, Liya Palagashvili, Michael D. Farren
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Simple theoretical models of job search can imply that a higher minimum wage increases the number of job seekers for affected jobs. Researchers often appeal to these models in defending or explaining non-negative estimated employment effects of minimum wages. We use novel data on job search in U.S. states to examine the effect of minimum wage increases on the number of job seekers for low-skilled positions. We find little if any evidence that higher minimum wages increase job search for low-skilled jobs, and more evidence that higher minimum wages decrease the number of workers seeking employment in these jobs.
abstract_zh: 简单的求职理论模型可能暗示，最低工资提高会增加受影响职位的求职者数量。研究者常引用这些模型来为最低工资的非负就业效应估计进行辩护或解释。我们利用美国各州关于求职的新数据，考察最低工资上调对低技能岗位求职者数量的影响。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明更高的最低工资会增加低技能工作的求职活动，反而有更多证据显示，更高的最低工资会减少寻求这些岗位就业的工人数量。

official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We measure the Euro Area (EA) output gap and potential output using a non-stationary dynamic factor model estimated on a large dataset of macroeconomic and financial variables. From 2012 to 2023, we estimate that the EA economy was tighter than the European Commission and the International Monetary Fund estimate, suggesting that the slow EA growth is the result of a potential output issue, not a business cycle issue. Moreover, we find that credit indicators are crucial for pinning down the output gap, as excluding them leads to estimating a lower output gap in periods of debt build-up and a higher gap in periods of deleveraging.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个基于大型宏观经济与金融变量数据集估计的非平稳动态因子模型，来衡量欧元区（EA）产出缺口与潜在产出。从2012年至2023年，我们估算出欧元区经济比欧盟委员会和国际货币基金组织的估计更为紧张，这表明欧元区增长缓慢源于潜在产出问题，而非商业周期问题。此外，我们发现信贷指标对于确定产出缺口至关重要，因为排除这些指标会导致在债务累积时期估计出较低的产出缺口，而在去杠杆时期估计出较高的缺口。

title: Identification and Estimation of Demand Models with Endogenous Product Entry and Exit

authors: Victor Aguirregabiria, Alessandro Iaria, Senay Sokullu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms introduce products in markets where they anticipate stronger demand, using information unobserved by researchers. This creates endogenous selection in demand estimation. In differentiated-product oligopolies, multidimensional demand unobservables and strategic entry can render the ordinary propensity score insufficient for selection correction. Existing approaches either restrict firms' information at entry or jointly estimate demand, pricing, and entry under strong supply-side assumptions. We derive a new mixture representation of the selection-bias function using latent propensity scores: entry probabilities conditional on observables and a latent market state generating dependence across entry decisions. This representation yields a convenient two-step semiparametric estimator that corrects for selection and price endogeneity while accommodating richer information at entry. The approach makes weaker supply-side assumptions and is simpler to implement because it avoids repeatedly solving the full model. Applied to the US airline industry, the method yields more elastic demand and less market power than estimates ignoring endogenous entry.
abstract_zh: 企业在预期需求更强的市场中推出产品，这一决策基于研究者无法观测的信息。这导致需求估计中存在内生选择问题。在差异化产品寡头市场中，多维度的需求不可观测因素与策略性进入行为，使得普通倾向得分不足以修正选择偏差。现有方法要么限制企业进入时的信息集，要么在强供给端假设下联合估计需求、定价与进入决策。我们利用潜在倾向得分推导出选择偏差函数的新混合表示形式：即基于可观测变量与一个生成跨进入决策依赖性的潜在市场状态的条件进入概率。该表示形式可构建便捷的两步半参数估计量，在修正选择偏差与价格内生性的同时，允许企业进入时拥有更丰富的信息。该方法对供给端假设要求更弱，且因无需反复求解完整模型而更易实施。应用于美国航空业时，相较于忽略内生进入的估计结果，该方法得出更具弹性的需求与更低的市场势力。

title: Measuring Economic Policy Uncertainty
title_zh: 经济政策不确定性的测度
title_primary: 经济政策不确定性的测度
title_secondary: Measuring Economic Policy Uncertainty
authors: Scott Baker, Nicholas Bloom, Steven Davis, Dimitris Georgarakos, Kwang Hwan Kim 等
official: 官方在线 2015-10-25 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a new index of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) based on newspaper coverage frequency. Several types of evidence ? including human readings of 12,000 newspaper articles ? indicate that our index proxies for movements in policy-related economic uncertainty. Our US index spikes near tight presidential elections, Gulf Wars I and II, the 9/11 attacks, the failure of Lehman Brothers, the 2011 debt-ceiling dispute and other major battles over fiscal policy. Using firm-level data, we find that policy uncertainty raises stock price volatility and reduces investment and employment in policy-sensitive sectors like defense, healthcare, and infrastructure construction. At the macro level, policy uncertainty innovations foreshadow declines in investment, output, and employment in the United States and, in a panel VAR setting, for 12 major economies. Extending our US index back to 1900, EPU rose dramatically in the 1930s (from late 1931) and has drifted upwards since the 1960s.
abstract_zh: 我们基于报纸报道频率构建了一个新的经济政策不确定性（EPU）指数。多种证据——包括对12,000篇报纸文章的人工解读——表明，该指数能够有效反映政策相关经济不确定性的变动。我们的美国指数在总统大选胶着期、第一次和第二次海湾战争、"9·11"恐怖袭击、雷曼兄弟破产、2011年债务上限争议以及其他重大财政政策博弈期间出现显著峰值。利用企业层面数据，我们发现政策不确定性会提高股票价格波动性，并减少国防、医疗保健和基础设施建设等政策敏感部门的投资与就业。在宏观层面，政策不确定性冲击预示着美国投资、产出和就业的下降，而在面板VAR模型中，这一结论对12个主要经济体同样成立。将美国指数回溯至1900年，EPU在20世纪30年代（自1931年末起）急剧攀升，并自20世纪60年代以来呈持续上升趋势。

title: Asymmetric Platform Oligopoly
title_zh: 非对称平台寡头
title_primary: 非对称平台寡头
title_secondary: Asymmetric Platform Oligopoly
authors: Martin Peitz, Susumu Sato
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a tractable model of asymmetric platform oligopoly with logit demand in which users from two distinct groups are subject to within‐group and cross‐group network effects and decide which platform to join. We characterize the equilibrium when platforms manage user access by setting participation fees for each user group. We explore the effects of platform entry, a change of incumbent platforms' quality under free entry, and the degree of compatibility. We show how the analysis can be extended to partial user participation.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个可处理的非对称平台寡头模型，该模型采用对数需求函数，其中来自两个不同群体的用户受到组内和组间网络效应的影响，并决定加入哪个平台。我们刻画了平台通过为每个用户群体设定参与费来管理用户接入时的均衡状态。我们探讨了平台进入、自由进入条件下在位平台质量变化以及兼容性程度的影响。我们还展示了如何将分析扩展至部分用户参与的情形。

title: Growing global shipping costs increase population mortality in Africa
title_zh: 全球航运成本上升加剧非洲人口死亡率
title_primary: 全球航运成本上升加剧非洲人口死亡率
title_secondary: Growing global shipping costs increase population mortality in Africa
authors: Yingnan Niu, Pengjun Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Reducing mortality is vital for Africa, whose economy depends on global shipping. This paper provides novel insights into the effects of global shipping costs on population mortality, which has been largely overlooked. For the first time, we investigated the relationship between shipping costs and population mortality across 45 African countries from 2000 to 2020. We found that the rising dry bulk shipping cost was significantly associated with higher population mortality, particularly among women in African countries, which were net importers of dry bulk commodities. It was revealed that East Africa was more vulnerable to shipping cost shocks than West Africa. Furthermore, by integrating climate factors with a long short-term memory model, we predicted the trends in shipping costs for 2040, 2070, and 2100 under different climate change scenarios and investigated the potential threats these changes pose to population mortality in Africa. The results show that population mortality in Africa is likely to face increasing challenges due to the rise in shipping costs under future climate change scenarios and global disruptions such as pandemics and financial crises. The population mortality in Africa may reach 10.06143 - 12.1939 deaths per 1,000 people, with total deaths ranging from 15.90 to 31.36 million. These findings provide new insights into the potential benefits of reducing global shipping costs for improving health outcomes in Africa.
abstract_zh: 降低死亡率对非洲至关重要，因其经济依赖于全球航运。本文对全球航运成本对人口死亡率的影响提供了新颖见解，这一领域此前在很大程度上被忽视。我们首次研究了2000年至2020年间45个非洲国家航运成本与人口死亡率之间的关系。研究发现，干散货航运成本的上升与人口死亡率的增加显著相关，尤其是在作为干散货商品净进口国的非洲国家中的女性群体。分析揭示，东非相较于西非更容易受到航运成本冲击的影响。此外，通过将气候因素与长短期记忆模型相结合，我们预测了在不同气候变化情景下2040年、2070年及2100年的航运成本趋势，并探讨了这些变化对非洲人口死亡率构成的潜在威胁。结果显示，在未来气候变化情景及全球性干扰（如疫情和金融危机）下，非洲人口死亡率可能面临日益严峻的挑战。非洲的人口死亡率可能达到每千人10.06143至12.1939人死亡，总死亡人数介于1590万至3136万之间。这些发现为降低全球航运成本以改善非洲健康结果提供了新的视角。

title: Bayesian Coalitional Rationality in Games: An Informational Foundation
title_zh: 博弈中的贝叶斯联盟理性：一个信息基础
title_primary: 博弈中的贝叶斯联盟理性：一个信息基础
title_secondary: Bayesian Coalitional Rationality in Games: An Informational Foundation
authors: Xiao Luo, Yongchuan Qiao, Chih-Chun Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The rational behavior of a coalition requires the informational precondition that its members take into account the behavior and beliefs of others. In noncooperative games, we define Bayesian coalitional rationality as a mode of collective behavior that no coalition of players wishes to change, in the sense that there is no coalition-wise common belief that mutual gains can be achieved through a tacit coalitional agreement. We establish a fundamental possibility result: the assumption of Bayesian coalitional rationality and common belief of Bayesian coalitional rationality is attainable in a finite model. Under a belief-richness condition, this assumption characterizes the solution concept of Bayesian coalitional rationalizability. Our approach also provides a novel notion of individual rationality in game situations where players may be uncertain about their own types and strategy choices.
abstract_zh: 联盟的理性行为要求一个信息前提，即其成员需考虑他人的行为与信念。在非合作博弈中，我们将贝叶斯联盟理性定义为一种集体行为模式，即任何玩家联盟都不希望改变现状，其含义在于不存在联盟层面的共同信念，认为通过默契的联盟协议可以实现相互增益。我们确立了一个基本可能性结果：贝叶斯联盟理性及对其的共同信念假设在有限模型中是可实现的。在信念丰富性条件下，这一假设刻画了贝叶斯联盟理性化的解概念。我们的方法还为玩家可能对自身类型和策略选择不确定的博弈情境提供了一种新颖的个体理性概念。

title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
title_zh: 石油经济体应担忧石油冲击对银行体系的影响吗？以阿曼为例
title_primary: 石油经济体应担忧石油冲击对银行体系的影响吗？以阿曼为例
title_secondary: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
authors: Yurii Sholomytskyi & Nathaniel Butler Blondel & Mr. Mumtaz Hussain
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.
abstract_zh: 本文以阿曼为案例，研究石油价格冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。我们构建了一个包含内生信贷配给与主权财富基金稳定规则的银行模块的DSGE模型，该模型根据阿曼制度目标进行校准，并采用贝叶斯方法进行约束。我们的结构方法区分了两种主要传导渠道：由信用风险与不良贷款驱动的偿付能力渠道，以及由顺周期的政府存款提取与主权债券发行驱动的流动性渠道。结构方差分解显示，石油价格冲击解释了非石油GDP方差的54%以上及信贷方差的53%，而银行资本冲击的贡献率不足0.1%，证实了流动性渠道在数量上的主导地位。我们识别出一种预防性流动性动机——即"流动性缓冲陷阱"——银行在经济繁荣期持有超额流动性以对冲碳氢化合物波动，从而结构性抑制了对生产性部门的信贷供给。反事实制度分析揭示了信贷深度的稳定效应：银行保守主义保护了长期实物资本形成，而"2040愿景"下企业部门持续金融化——包括伊斯兰银行与苏库克市场的快速增长——进一步放大了这种结构性韧性。我们承认小样本结构估计中固有的识别挑战，并讨论了关键建模假设对结果的敏感性。

title: When Digital Nudges Nag: Evidence on Program Take-up from a WhatsApp Intervention
title_zh: 当数字助推变成唠叨：来自WhatsApp干预的项目参与证据
title_primary: 当数字助推变成唠叨：来自WhatsApp干预的项目参与证据
title_secondary: When Digital Nudges Nag: Evidence on Program Take-up from a WhatsApp Intervention
authors: Moya, Andrés, Rozo, Sandra V., Urbina, María José
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies a randomized controlled trial in which undocumented Venezuelan migrants in Colombia were assigned to receive informational videos via WhatsApp encouraging registration in a regularization program. The intervention backfired. Receiving a video reduced take-up by 8 percentage points, a 15 percent decline relative to the control mean. The negative effect operated through two channels. Among individuals who watched, exposure to procedural content discouraged registration. Among those who did not engage, unsolicited contact itself reduced take-up. Both effects were concentrated among individuals at the margin of the decision to participate. These findings challenge the assumption that well-designed informational nudges are, at worst, neutral.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验，其中哥伦比亚境内的无证委内瑞拉移民被随机分配接收通过WhatsApp发送的鼓励其参与正规化计划注册的信息视频。该干预措施产生了反效果。接收视频使参与率降低了8个百分点，相较于对照组均值下降了15%。这一负面效应通过两个渠道发挥作用：在观看视频的个体中，接触程序性内容抑制了注册行为；在未观看视频的个体中，未经请求的接触本身降低了参与率。两种效应均集中于处于参与决策边缘的群体。这些发现挑战了"精心设计的信息助推措施至多仅具中性效果"的假设。

title: Beyond one-size-fits-all: Adaptive pathways in property tax base
title_zh: 超越一刀切：财产税基的适应性路径
title_primary: 超越一刀切：财产税基的适应性路径
title_secondary: Beyond one-size-fits-all: Adaptive pathways in property tax base
authors: Małgorzata Renigier-Biłozor, Alina Źróbek-Różańska, Jakub Jurewicz, Tuğba Güneş
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Amid fiscal pressures and rising public expectations, the long-standing choice of value (ad valorem) versus area as the base for recurrent property taxation has regained prominence. This study identifies when each base performs better across heterogeneous institutional and market contexts. Evidence combines an international expert survey (n = 39, 23 countries) with a structured literature review; findings are organised with a TOWS matrix to link system characteristics to practicable reform options. Unlike many comparative approaches, which focus primarily on assessing the position of the entity under study relative to other entities, the TOWS matrix allows one to move from diagnosing the situation to identifying potential courses of action. Results indicate that value-based assessment is preferable where credible price evidence, regular revaluations, and coherent appeals procedures are in place. An area-based assessment can be justified under limited data and capacity, and the need for ease of implementation and maintenance with constrained resources. The analysis clarifies trade-offs among equity of burdens, administrative efficiency/revenue performance, and public acceptance, and distils criteria for selecting the tax base aligned to institutional and market maturity. Rather than advocating a one-size-fits-all solution, the article sets out context-sensitive, adaptive reform strategies tailored to different stages of institutional and market development. Hybrid or phased approaches are presented as realistic pathways to align annual property taxes with goals of equity, reliable revenues, and administrative feasibility.
abstract_zh: 在财政压力与公众期望上升的背景下，经常性财产税中从价计征与按面积计征这一长期存在的税基选择问题再度受到关注。本研究识别了在不同制度与市场情境下，何种税基表现更优。证据综合了一项国际专家调查（n=39，涉及23个国家）与结构化文献综述；研究结果通过TOWS矩阵加以组织，以将制度特征与可行的改革方案相衔接。与许多主要聚焦于评估研究对象相对于其他实体地位的比较方法不同，TOWS矩阵使分析能够从情境诊断转向潜在行动方案的识别。结果表明，在具备可信价格证据、定期重估及连贯申诉程序的情况下，从价评估更为可取；而在数据与能力有限、且资源约束下需兼顾实施简便性与维护可行性的情形中，按面积计征具有其合理性。分析厘清了负担公平性、行政效率/收入绩效与公众接受度之间的权衡关系，并提炼出与制度及市场成熟度相匹配的税基选择标准。本文并非倡导一刀切的解决方案，而是针对制度与市场发展的不同阶段，提出情境敏感、适应性强的改革策略。混合式或分阶段路径被视为使年度财产税与公平目标、稳定收入及行政可行性相协调的现实途径。

title: How do countries benefit from participating in the global value chain? A comprehensive panel analysis of heterogeneity in GVC impacts
title_zh: 各国如何从参与全球价值链中获益？GVC影响异质性的综合面板分析
title_primary: 各国如何从参与全球价值链中获益？GVC影响异质性的综合面板分析
title_secondary: How do countries benefit from participating in the global value chain? A comprehensive panel analysis of heterogeneity in GVC impacts
authors: Jiarui Liu, Takuji Kinkyo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Global trade has shifted from the traditional exchange of finished goods to the widespread integration of global value chains (GVCs). The expansion of GVCs has important implications for both developed and developing economies. We construct a framework to explain how GVC participation affects GDP per capita and how these effects differ across countries at different income levels by analysing types of GVC activities and the mediating role of total factor productivity (TFP). We use advanced econometric methods, including fixed-effects models, two-stage least squares estimators, system generalized method of moments estimators, and fixed-effects quantile regression, to provide detailed insights into the differential effects of GVC participation. Our results show that the impact of GVC participation on economic growth varies by income level. For low-income countries, backward GVC participation significantly affects GDP per capita, while forward GVC participation has significant effects only for upper-middle- and high-income countries. We also find that TFP mediates the impact of GVC participation on GDP per capita.
abstract_zh: 全球贸易已从传统的成品交换转向全球价值链（GVC）的广泛整合。全球价值链的扩张对发达经济体和发展中经济体均具有重要影响。我们构建了一个分析框架，通过考察全球价值链活动的类型以及全要素生产率（TFP）的中介作用，阐释全球价值链参与如何影响人均GDP，以及这种影响在不同收入水平国家间的差异。我们采用先进的计量经济学方法，包括固定效应模型、两阶段最小二乘估计量、系统广义矩估计量以及固定效应分位数回归，以深入揭示全球价值链参与效应的异质性。研究结果表明，全球价值链参与对经济增长的影响因收入水平而异。对于低收入国家，后向全球价值链参与对人均GDP具有显著影响；而前向全球价值链参与仅对中高收入和高收入国家产生显著效应。我们还发现，全要素生产率在全球价值链参与对人均GDP的影响中发挥中介作用。

abstract: This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.
abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。

title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge
title_zh: 感知通胀楔子
title_primary: 感知通胀楔子

authors: Neville Francis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Standard measures of inflation, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), are designed to measure changes in the cost of living, not how households perceive price changes under limited attention and imperfect information. This paper introduces Perceived Inflation (PI), an attention-weighted inflation measure derived from a model in which households allocate attention across goods and observe noisy price signals. I construct monthly PI using disaggregated CPI data and attention proxies based on price salience, volatility, media mentions, and search behavior. The resulting PI series is highly correlated with CPI inflation but exhibits greater short-run volatility, especially during the Global Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 recession, and the 2021–22 inflation surge. A state-space version of the index implies a persistent latent attention component and a time-varying PI wedge. Finally, the paper embeds the estimated PI wedge into a heterogeneous-household model to demonstrate how attention-driven distortions in inflation perceptions affect saving and consumption through perceived real returns.
abstract_zh: 标准通胀指标（如消费者价格指数CPI）旨在衡量生活成本的变化，而非家庭在有限注意力和不完美信息条件下对价格变动的感知。本文提出感知通胀（Perceived Inflation, PI）这一概念，它是一种基于注意力加权的通胀衡量指标，源于家庭在不同商品间分配注意力并观测含噪声价格信号的模型。我利用细分CPI数据以及基于价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道和搜索行为的注意力代理变量，构建了月度PI序列。所得PI序列与CPI通胀高度相关，但短期波动性更大，尤其在金融危机、新冠疫情衰退及2021-2022年通胀飙升期间。该指数的状态空间版本揭示了持续存在的潜在注意力成分和时变PI偏差。最后，本文将估计的PI偏差嵌入异质性家庭模型，以论证注意力驱动的通胀感知扭曲如何通过感知实际回报影响储蓄与消费。

title: Additionality of Afforestation Incentives: Evidence from the Conservation Reserve Program
title_zh: 造林激励的额外性：来自保护储备计划的证据
title_primary: 造林激励的额外性：来自保护储备计划的证据
title_secondary: Additionality of Afforestation Incentives: Evidence from the Conservation Reserve Program
authors: Andrew B. Rosenberg, Benjamin M. Gramig, Peter Beeson, Rich Iovanna
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Afforestation, which involves converting cropland to forestland, can provide multiple ecosystem services. Consequently, public incentive programs such as those administered by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and, increasingly, private incentive programs, provide funding to farmers to convert their land to forest. However, the degree to which afforestation incentives provide greater ecosystem services depends on the degree to which afforestation is additional, both in the short- and long-term. Incentives are additional if they lead to forest growth that would not have occurred without payments. In this study, we assess the additionality of incentives for afforestation of cropland in USDA's Conservation Reserve Program over a two-decade time span. We estimate impacts using a regression discontinuity design that leverages the Conservation Reserve Program's General Signup auction mechanism. We use remote-sensing data to compare the extent of trees on land that had rejected and accepted offers to enroll in the program. We find that 32 to 65 percent of land enrolled is additional; and that impacts of incentives on tree cover remain steady from nine to twenty years after initial offers are made.
abstract_zh: 造林，即将农田转变为林地，能够提供多种生态系统服务。因此，公共激励计划，如美国农业部（USDA）管理的项目，以及日益增多的私人激励计划，向农民提供资金以将其土地转为林地。然而，造林激励措施所能带来的生态系统服务增量，取决于造林在短期和长期内的额外性程度。如果激励措施促进了在没有补贴情况下不会发生的森林增长，则这些激励具有额外性。在本研究中，我们评估了美国农业部保护储备计划中农田造林激励措施在二十年时间跨度内的额外性。我们利用回归不连续设计，借助保护储备计划的一般签约拍卖机制来估计影响。我们使用遥感数据，比较了被拒绝和接受加入该计划提议的土地上的树木覆盖程度。我们发现，32%至65%的已注册土地具有额外性；且激励措施对树木覆盖的影响在初始提议提出后的九至二十年间保持稳定。

title: Teachers' sick leave and summer timing: an impact evaluation
title_zh: 教师病假与暑假时间安排：一项影响评估
title_primary: 教师病假与暑假时间安排：一项影响评估
title_secondary: Teachers' sick leave and summer timing: an impact evaluation
authors: Delgado-Cubillo, Pablo, Moral-Arce, Ignacio, Martín-Román, Ángel Luis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们采用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析基于双重差分框架，利用学年周期进行定制化回归，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年周期。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。同时，返岗概率的常规差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性以及涉及更主观或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。

title: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
title_zh: 异质性企业与内生加成定价下的一般均衡进入与福利
title_primary: 异质性企业与内生加成定价下的一般均衡进入与福利
title_secondary: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
authors: Kyle Bagwell, Seung Hoon Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了无外部商品的单部门与两部门封闭经济Melitz–Ottaviano（MO）模型中的市场进入效率。通过比较市场结果与次优结果，我们发现单部门模型中的市场进入是有效的。这一有效性在对称的两部门设定中同样成立。当部门间存在非对称需求且非对称程度足够小时，市场会导致“高需求”部门出现过度进入。这种无效率源于MO偏好中额外加总因子的存在。

title: Making stablecoins stabler(r): can regulation help?
title_zh: 使稳定币更稳定：监管能否发挥作用？
title_primary: 使稳定币更稳定：监管能否发挥作用？
title_secondary: Making stablecoins stabler(r): can regulation help?
authors: Tirupam Goel, Ulf Lewrick, Isha Agarwal
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We model a stablecoin issuer that optimises capital, cash and bond holdings under persistent stablecoin flows. Absent regulation, the issuer holds little capital and favours interest-bearing but less-liquid bonds over cash. This exposes coin-holders to default risks and poses systemic spillovers via price impact of bond fire-sales. How can regulation mitigate these risks? We consider capital and liquidity thresholds as usable buffers. They can be breached in stress but discipline issuers by triggering additional redemptions, thus endogenising stablecoin flows. The thresholds work through asymmetric channels. While the liquidity threshold only raises cash holdings, the capital threshold increases both capital and cash. Both thresholds mitigate default and spillover risks, suggesting they are substitutes. However, they are complements for regulators targeting both risks. Using stablecoin flows and US Treasury market depth, we calibrate a two-way mapping that enables regulators to recover capital-liquidity threshold combinations implied by chosen risk targets (and vice-versa).
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个稳定币发行商的模型，该发行商在持续稳定的币流下优化资本、现金和债券持有量。在缺乏监管的情况下，发行商持有少量资本，并倾向于持有有息但流动性较低的债券而非现金。这使币持有者面临违约风险，并通过债券抛售的价格影响产生系统性溢出效应。监管如何缓解这些风险？我们考虑将资本和流动性阈值作为可用的缓冲机制。这些阈值在压力时期可能被突破，但通过触发额外赎回对发行商形成约束，从而内生化稳定币流动。阈值通过非对称渠道发挥作用：流动性阈值仅提高现金持有量，而资本阈值则同时增加资本和现金。两种阈值均能缓解违约和溢出风险，表明它们具有替代性。然而，对于同时针对这两种风险的监管者而言，它们又具有互补性。利用稳定币流动和美国国债市场深度数据，我们校准了一个双向映射关系，使监管者能够根据选定的风险目标反推出资本-流动性阈值的组合（反之亦然）。

title: Defining informality in a Southern European City indicators of informality in the CEP neighborhood, Palermo
title_zh: 定义南欧城市非正规性：巴勒莫CEP社区的非正规性指标
title_primary: 定义南欧城市非正规性：巴勒莫CEP社区的非正规性指标
title_secondary: Defining informality in a Southern European City indicators of informality in the CEP neighborhood, Palermo
authors: Meghdad Kahvand, Marco Picone, Michelangelo Carraro, Mona Saadvandi, Annalisa Giampino
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Urban informality in Southern Europe remains an underexplored yet significant phenomenon, challenging dominant frameworks that primarily address informality in the Global South. This study examines the Centro Espansione Periferica (CEP) neighborhood in Palermo, Italy, to develop a taxonomy of informal settlement indicators suited to Southern European cities' specific governance, socio-economic, and spatial characteristics. Using a qualitative methodology grounded in Grounded Theory, this research integrates semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations to capture the complexities of informality in a regulated urban environment. Findings reveal that informality in CEP emerges from economic hardship and governance failures, ambiguous tenure arrangements, and spatial adaptations within public housing initiatives. The study highlights key informality indicators, including weak institutional oversight, socio-spatial transformations, and informal negotiations between residents and public authorities. This taxonomy challenges binary classifications of informality and calls for a more nuanced, context-sensitive approach to land-use policies in European urban contexts. This research provides valuable perspectives for urban management and sustainable development approaches in cities facing comparable issues by emphasizing staged formalization, inclusive planning, and tailored policy measures.
abstract_zh: 南欧的城市非正规性仍是一个尚未充分探索却意义重大的现象，它对主要关注全球南方非正规性的主流分析框架构成了挑战。本研究以意大利巴勒莫的Centro Espansione Periferica（CEP）社区为案例，旨在构建一套适用于南欧城市特定治理、社会经济及空间特征的非正规聚落指标分类体系。研究采用基于扎根理论的定性方法，整合半结构化访谈、文献分析和实地观察，以捕捉受规制城市环境中非正规性的复杂性。研究发现，CEP的非正规性源于经济困境与治理失灵、模糊的产权安排以及公共住房项目中的空间适应性调整。研究揭示了关键的非正规性指标，包括制度监管薄弱、社会空间转型以及居民与公共当局之间的非正式协商。该分类体系挑战了非正规性的二元划分，并呼吁在欧洲城市语境下采取更具情境敏感性的土地政策路径。通过强调分阶段正规化、包容性规划及针对性政策措施，本研究为面临类似问题的城市提供了城市管理与可持续发展方面的重要参考视角。

title: Meta-Analysis of Distributional Preferences
title_zh: 分配偏好的元分析
title_primary: 分配偏好的元分析
title_secondary: Meta-Analysis of Distributional Preferences
authors: Salvatore Nunnari, Massimiliano Pozzi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of distributional preferences, examining 297 estimates of sensitivity to inequality from 41 articles that structurally estimate the Fehr and Schmidt (1999) model. Our analysis indicates that individuals are inequality averse: mean sensitivity to disadvantageous and advantageous inequality are, respectively, 0.533 and 0.326. We also uncover systematic heterogeneity: aversion to advantageous (disadvantageous) inequality is smaller (larger) in strategic environments. Finally, we examine 98 estimates of altruism and attitude towards equity versus efficiency from 17 studies structurally estimating the Andreoni and Miller (2002) model. The representative individual displays Cobb–Douglas preferences with roughly 1/3 weight on others’ earnings.
abstract_zh: 我们对分配偏好进行了一项元分析，考察了来自41篇文献的297个不平等敏感度估计值，这些文献均采用结构估计方法对Fehr和Schmidt（1999）模型进行估计。分析表明，个体具有不平等厌恶倾向：对不利不平等和有利不平等的平均敏感度分别为0.533和0.326。我们还发现了系统性异质性：在策略性环境中，对有利（不利）不平等的厌恶程度较小（较大）。最后，我们考察了来自17项研究的98个利他主义及公平与效率态度的估计值，这些研究均采用结构估计方法对Andreoni和Miller（2002）模型进行估计。代表性个体表现出柯布-道格拉斯偏好，其中他人收益的权重约为1/3。

title: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
title_zh: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用
title_primary: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用
title_secondary: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
authors: Niko Jaakkola, Florian Wagener
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略的剖面唯一映射回策略空间。由此，我们使广泛一类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好的性质，解决了一个长期存在的开放性问题。我们给出了一个易于应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们通过一个非合作减缓气候变化的经典模型展示了该方法。我们的方法提供了新颖且具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡集，并证明最优均衡相较于以往文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可被视为关于良好均衡的协调，而非在动态囚徒困境的有限剩余上进行讨价还价。

title: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
title_zh: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动
title_primary: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动
title_secondary: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
authors: Eva Boonaert, Eva‐Marie Meemken, Miet Maertens
official: 官方在线 2026-05-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Prior research analyzes the economic effects of Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS)—such as Fairtrade, Organic, and GlobalGAP—but little is known about the stability of these effects over time. Using a nationally representative farm survey of Peru (2015–2019), this study analyzes whether VSS certification is associated with reduced inter‐annual price and yield volatility. Applying pooled OLS, matching, and internal instruments, we find that certification is associated with 27% lower price volatility and 17% lower yield volatility, particularly benefiting family farms, translating into an 81% reduction in their net farm revenue volatility. The results highlight VSS' potential to enhance revenue stability.
abstract_zh: 已有研究分析了自愿性可持续标准（VSS）——如公平贸易、有机认证和全球良好农业规范——的经济效应，但关于这些效应随时间稳定性的认知仍十分有限。本研究利用秘鲁全国代表性农户调查数据（2015-2019年），分析VSS认证是否与降低的年际价格波动和产量波动相关。通过混合OLS回归、匹配法和内部工具变量法，我们发现认证与价格波动降低27%、产量波动降低17%显著相关，其中家庭农场受益尤为突出，其净农场收入波动降幅达81%。研究结果凸显了VSS在增强收入稳定性方面的潜力。

title: Management of Spent Mushroom Substrate in Odisha, India: Determinants, Impacts and Scope for the Circular Bioeconomy
title_zh: 印度奥里萨邦废弃蘑菇基质的管理：决定因素、影响与循环生物经济前景
title_primary: 印度奥里萨邦废弃蘑菇基质的管理：决定因素、影响与循环生物经济前景
title_secondary: Management of Spent Mushroom Substrate in Odisha, India: Determinants, Impacts and Scope for the Circular Bioeconomy
authors: Dibyajyoti Samantaray, Hemanta Das, N. B. Singh
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Mushroom cultivation is rapidly gaining prominence as a sustainable farming system. However, it generates substantial quantities of spent mushroom substrate (SMS), posing challenges for waste management and environmental sustainability. Therefore, developing circular bioeconomic approaches is crucial for the sustainable management of SMS. This study examines the SMS management approaches practiced by mushroom farmers in Odisha, India, and the factors influencing their management choices as well as their impact on mushroom productivity. It was observed that farmers primarily practice three SMS management approaches: farm‐site deposition, composting and distant dumping. The results of the multinomial endogenous switching regression (MESR) model indicate that factors such as education, farming experience, access to extension services and infrastructure significantly influence the choice of SMS management approach. These management approaches were found to have a significant impact on mushroom productivity. The study recommends policies that promote waste management infrastructure aligned with circular bioeconomy principles, fostering sustainable mushroom farming.
abstract_zh: 摘要 蘑菇种植作为一种可持续农业系统正迅速受到重视。然而，其产生的大量废弃蘑菇基质（SMS）给废物管理和环境可持续性带来了挑战。因此，发展循环生物经济方法对于SMS的可持续管理至关重要。本研究考察了印度奥里萨邦蘑菇种植户所采用的SMS管理方法，以及影响其管理选择的因素及其对蘑菇生产力的影响。研究发现，种植户主要采用三种SMS管理方法：农场现场堆放、堆肥化和远距离倾倒。多项内生转换回归（MESR）模型的结果表明，教育水平、种植经验、推广服务获取和基础设施等因素显著影响SMS管理方法的选择。这些管理方法被发现对蘑菇生产力有显著影响。本研究建议制定促进符合循环生物经济原则的废物管理基础设施的政策，以推动可持续蘑菇种植。

title: Serial Investing and Strategic Commitment in Markets With Unknown Competitors
title_zh: 未知竞争市场中的序列投资与战略承诺

authors: Naveen Khanna, Richmond Mathews
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how serial investors who regularly face unknown competitors attempt to make their projects dominant. Innovating in new markets often involves uncertainty over the nature of the final product and who the key competitors will be. Such projects also have long-term funding needs, so a commitment to provide the necessary funds imparts a strategic advantage vis-a-vis potential rivals. We show that cultivating a reputation as a reliable financier can create a desirable competitive advantage across an investor's portfolio of projects. The downside is excessive reputation-seeking, which results in aggressive competition and over-investment in many product markets. Our results rationalize real-life aspects of innovation and provide new testable predictions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究那些经常面对未知竞争对手的连续投资者如何试图使其项目占据主导地位。在新市场中创新往往涉及最终产品性质及关键竞争对手的不确定性。此类项目还需长期资金支持，因此承诺提供必要资金能赋予其相对于潜在对手的战略优势。我们表明，培养作为可靠融资者的声誉可以在投资者的项目组合中创造理想的竞争优势。其弊端在于过度追求声誉，导致在许多产品市场中竞争激烈且投资过度。我们的研究结果合理化了现实中的创新现象，并提供了新的可检验预测。

title: Towards a Sustainable Recovery for Lebanon’s Economy
title_zh: 迈向黎巴嫩经济的可持续复苏

title_secondary: Towards a Sustainable Recovery for Lebanon’s Economy
authors: Ricardo Hausmann, Ugo Panizza, Carmen Reinhart, Douglas Barrios, Clement Brenot 等
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Lebanon’s current economic crisis ranks among the worst in recent history. GDP has collapsed by 38% in real terms. The Lebanese lira, which was fixed to the dollar in 1997, has lost more than 98% of its value on the parallel market. The government has defaulted on its debt, and depositors are unable to access their funds held at commercial banks. Consolidated public sector debt, including both government debt and commercial banks’ claims on the Banque du Liban (BdL), represents more than seven times the current GDP. Public services delivery has crumbled. In short, the country is undergoing a debt crisis, a banking crisis, a currency crisis, and a growth collapse. Four years into the crisis, a resolution remains elusive, and each passing day increases the economic and social burdens faced by the population. Given the increasing cost of delaying a resolution, we propose a strategy for Lebanon’s economic recovery that addresses all the dimensions of the crisis while recognizing the need to rapidly kick-start the economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 黎巴嫩当前的经济危机堪称近代史上最严重的危机之一。实际国内生产总值（GDP）暴跌38%。1997年与美元挂钩的黎巴嫩镑，在平行市场已贬值超过98%。政府债务违约，储户无法提取商业银行存款。包括政府债务及商业银行对黎巴嫩央行（BdL）债权在内的公共部门合并债务，已达当前GDP的七倍以上。公共服务体系全面崩溃。简言之，该国正同时经历债务危机、银行危机、货币危机与增长崩溃。危机爆发四年后，解决方案仍遥不可及，而每拖延一日，民众承受的经济与社会负担便愈发沉重。鉴于拖延解决的成本日益攀升，我们提出一项兼顾危机各维度、同时亟需快速启动经济复苏的黎巴嫩经济复苏战略。

title: Audit partners’ cultural trust and audit outcomes
title_zh: 审计合伙人的文化信任与审计结果
title_primary: 审计合伙人的文化信任与审计结果
title_secondary: Audit partners’ cultural trust and audit outcomes
authors: Inder K. Khurana, Bing Li, Kelvin Yeung, Elisha J. Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Building on economic theories of cultural transmission, we examine how audit partners’ cultural trust influences audit outcomes. Based on the “presumptive doubt” perspective of professional skepticism, we propose that audit partners from trusting cultures are more likely to rely on management’s assertions, while still exercising a high degree of caution and not naively trusting management. Consistent with our prediction, we find that audit partners from trusting cultures commit fewer Type I errors when issuing going concern opinions, without significantly increasing Type II errors. The reduction in Type I errors is primarily found when audit partners normally tend to be more conservative, and it is attenuated when management is less trustworthy. At the same time, audit partners from trusting cultures are also associated with more within-GAAP earnings management, suggesting that increased trust entails a cost. Collectively, our findings offer new insights into how cultural trust affects the assurance of accounting information.
abstract_zh: 基于文化传播的经济学理论，我们探讨了审计合伙人的文化信任如何影响审计结果。从职业怀疑的“推定怀疑”视角出发，我们提出，来自信任文化的审计合伙人更可能依赖管理层的陈述，同时仍保持高度谨慎，并非天真地信任管理层。与我们的预测一致，我们发现，来自信任文化的审计合伙人在出具持续经营意见时，犯第一类错误的概率较低，而并未显著增加第二类错误。第一类错误的减少主要出现在审计合伙人通常倾向于更为保守的情况下，并且在管理层可信度较低时，这一效应会减弱。同时，来自信任文化的审计合伙人也与更多的GAAP内盈余管理相关联，这表明增加的信任伴随着成本。总体而言，我们的发现为文化信任如何影响会计信息的保证提供了新的见解。

abstract: Can a substance abuse intervention lead to sustained social ties between vulnerable women? This study analyzes the results on peer relationship outcomes of a substance abuse intervention, which included group workshops and individual and spousal counseling sessions. Using dyadic estimations, we find evidence that the intervention strengthened relationships between female peers both assigned to the treatment sixteen months post-intervention. Results were especially pronounced between pairs of treatment women in which the first had a husband with highly regressive views (generally supports wife beating) and the second woman's husband did not. Among these dyadic peer links, we find that a woman is significantly more likely to receive money from her peer, speak daily with her peer, and attend a community organization with her peer relative to those in the control. The study contributes to our understanding of methods to improve support among those who have vulnerability to IPV through building links with those less vulnerable.
abstract_zh: 物质滥用干预能否促成弱势女性之间持续的社会联系？本研究分析了一项物质滥用干预措施对同伴关系结果的影响，该干预包括小组工作坊及个人和配偶咨询会议。通过二元估计方法，我们发现有证据表明，在干预后十六个月，该干预加强了被分配至治疗组的女性同伴之间的关系。这一效果在特定配对中尤为显著：即第一方女性其丈夫持有高度倒退观点（普遍支持殴打妻子），而第二方女性的丈夫则无此观点的治疗组女性之间。在这些二元同伴联系中，我们发现，相较于对照组，一位女性显著更有可能从她的同伴那里获得金钱、每日与同伴交谈，并与同伴一同参加社区组织活动。本研究增进了我们对如何通过建立与较少受暴力风险女性的联系，来改善易受亲密伴侣暴力侵害者支持方法的理解。

title: Does Deposit Insurance Promote Deposit Stability? Evidence from the Postal Savings System during the 1920s

title_primary: 存款保险是否促进了存款稳定？来自20世纪20年代邮政储蓄系统的证据
title_secondary: Does Deposit Insurance Promote Deposit Stability? Evidence from the Postal Savings System during the 1920s
authors: Lee K. Davison, Carlos D. Ramirez
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-12-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We evaluate whether deposit insurance (DI) promotes liquidity by influencing depositor behavior. We use the postal savings (PS) system and state‐adopted DI schemes during the 1920s to examine the effect of bank suspensions on PS deposit growth in pairs of border cities (DI versus non‐DI). After a nearby bank suspension, (i) deposits in non‐DI‐PS offices increase sevenfold compared to deposits in adjacent DI‐PS offices, and (ii) county‐level deposits per bank decline in non‐DI counties but not in adjacent DI counties. In both cases, the effect steadily declines through the 1920s, consistent with the decreasing viability of the DI schemes.
abstract_zh: 我们评估存款保险（DI）是否通过影响储户行为来促进流动性。我们利用1920年代的邮政储蓄（PS）系统及州级采纳的DI方案，考察银行停业对边境城市对（DI与非DI）中PS存款增长的影响。在邻近银行停业后，（i）非DI-PS办事处的存款相比相邻DI-PS办事处增长七倍，（ii）非DI县每银行的县级存款下降，而相邻DI县则无此现象。两种情况下，该效应在整个1920年代持续减弱，这与DI方案可行性逐渐降低的现象相符。
